title: All field types
description: Every supported field type on one page: text, email, textarea, number, date, month, select, multi-select, radio, checkbox, combobox, and a PDF resume upload.
about: Northwind Robotics builds warehouse automation for mid-market logistics operators. The engineering team is twelve people across four countries and ships to production several times a day.
responsibilities: Design and ship services that coordinate fleets of autonomous floor units.
Own features end to end, from the control-plane API through to the operator UI.
Work directly with the operations team that uses what you build.

title: Multi-step form
description: A two-step application: continue past step one, then submit on step two.
about: Cascade Analytics runs the reporting layer for several European retail groups. Small team, large volumes, strong opinions about data modelling.
responsibilities: Build and maintain the ingestion pipelines behind the customer-facing warehouse.
Keep a multi-tenant model honest as the tenant count grows.
Turn recurring analyst questions into modelled, tested datasets.

title: Validation errors
description: The form rejects everything except the exact invitation code ACCEPT, exercising correction rounds.
about: Helix Biotech is a contract research organisation working on assay development for clinical partners across the Benelux.
responsibilities: Run and document assay development work to protocol.
Maintain instrument calibration records and sample chain of custody.
Summarise results for the partner-facing scientific team.

title: Education & work history
description: Repeating sections: two education entries, three work entries, languages and skills — plus a one-time nested correction.
about: Meridian Group manages port-side logistics for bulk shippers. Long-standing contracts, tight margins, and a strong preference for people who have run a floor themselves.
responsibilities: Own the daily plan across three shifts and roughly ninety staff.
Hold the line on safety reporting and incident follow-through.
Work with terminal partners to keep turnaround inside contracted windows.

title: Login wall
description: The application demands credentials. The agent must fail safely with login_required — never type a password.
about: Vault Systems provides key management and hardware-backed signing to public-sector customers.
responsibilities: Review and harden the signing service and its supporting infrastructure.
Run the disclosure process and drive fixes to completion.
Support audit and certification work with real evidence, not narrative.

title: Slow page
description: The form mounts five seconds late behind a loading state, testing patience and quiescence detection.
about: Glacier Freight moves temperature-controlled cargo across northern Europe. Planning sits between the customer desk and the drivers, and gets the final say on the schedule.
responsibilities: Build the weekly plan across roughly two hundred temperature-controlled movements.
Re-plan around delays without breaking the cold chain.
Keep customers informed before they have to ask.

title: Cancel mid-run
description: Identical to the slow page — the difference is the customer canceling the application while it runs.
about: Glacier Freight moves temperature-controlled cargo across northern Europe. Planning sits between the customer desk and the drivers, and gets the final say on the schedule.
responsibilities: Build the weekly plan across roughly two hundred temperature-controlled movements.
Re-plan around delays without breaking the cold chain.
Keep customers informed before they have to ask.

title: Submission unconfirmed
description: The submit button disables itself but never actually submits, so confirmation can never be observed.
about: Foxglove Media is a small editorial studio producing long-form work for technology clients.
responsibilities: Own the editorial calendar across three retained clients.
Brief and edit a pool of freelance writers.
Report on what actually moved, not on what was published.

title: Conditional fields
description: Answering the first question reveals fields that were not in the DOM before, forcing the agent to re-discover mid-run.
about: Ardent Health runs clinical data management for late-phase trials across Belgium and the Netherlands.
responsibilities: Own database design and validation for assigned studies.
Reconcile external vendor data against the study database.
Keep the audit trail defensible from first entry to lock.

title: EEOC demographics
description: A voluntary self-identification block alongside the ordinary fields, exercising sensitive-field handling and decline-to-answer defaults.
about: Brightside Labs designs and builds diagnostic tools for primary-care practices.
responsibilities: Own end-to-end design for the practitioner-facing product.
Run research with clinicians and turn it into shipped changes.
Hold the accessibility bar for a product used under time pressure.

title: Typeahead location
description: An async combobox that fetches options after a short delay, exercising the typeahead escalation ladder and commit detection.
about: Lumen Transit plans and operates regional bus networks under public-service contracts in Denmark and southern Sweden.
responsibilities: Model network changes and their effect on contracted service levels.
Work with municipalities on timetable and route consultations.
Turn ridership data into concrete service proposals.

title: Email verification
description: Emails a one-time code after submit and will not finish until it is entered, exercising the verification round end to end.
about: Kestrel Financial administers regulated savings products for credit unions across Ireland and the UK.
responsibilities: Review onboarding files against current AML and KYC obligations.
Prepare the quarterly regulatory return and its supporting evidence.
Work with engineering on the controls that make the above routine.
